{+}In the SRS module{+}, select the offending object, then menu GDEB Customized->Review->Commenting->Reviewer Create Comment.  Fill out the dialog.  Select Apply, then Close.  The script opens the comment log, switched to edit mode, pastes your comment into it, adds your name, links back to the object you selected, and closes the comment log.  This allows reviews in parallel.   _Please do not directly edit the comment log to add comments, this locks out other reviewers._

column235:
06/Jan/26 11:58 AM;bdeshpan;Notes from Meeting 1/6/2026

- 54ms for SABT switchover
- SABT is normal seeking, SABT3 will normally be on starboard power
- +/- 14v for overvoltage and undervoltage protection
- Retransfer time of 1 second (after SABT switchover); before transferring back to starboard power (for SABT3) it will stay on port power for 1 second
- SABT can perform in-phase transfer of power
- After 54ms if it can't phase lock it might try random transfer, but generally SABT will always try to do in-phase transfer
- If ssw-2 is powered on first there will be a relay switchover when ssw-1 is powered up, ssw-1 should always be powered up first to achieve a normal state without relay switching;;;
